title: A single cell RNA sequencing protocol for the pig colon
author: Tao Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgdmjs46
materials: Tao Li, Pu-Qing Yuan, Yvette Taché
Single-cell capture, library construction, and sequencing

steps.title: Obtain and wash colon tissue
steps.instruction: Collect full‑thickness proximal, transverse, and distal colon samples from resection surgery, then wash them in ice‑cold PBS bubbled with carbogen (95 % O₂, 5 % CO₂); keep all solutions equilibrated in carbogen gas.

steps.title: Peel off outer smooth muscle
steps.instruction: Using forceps, carefully peel the outer smooth muscle layers together with the myenteric plexus away from the underlying tissue.

steps.title: Incubate muscle layer on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the peeled smooth muscle layer in enteric neuron medium (Neurobasal A + B‑27, 2 mM L‑glutamine, 1 % FBS, 10 ng ml⁻¹ glial‑derived neurotrophic factor, 1× antibiotic/antimycotic) containing 45 µM actinomycin D for 15 min on ice.

steps.title: Mince tissue and enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into pieces smaller than 1 mm, transfer to enteric neuron medium supplemented with 1 mg ml⁻¹ collagenase B, dispase II, and 45 µM actinomycin D, and incubate for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add DNase and dissociate cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mg ml⁻¹ deoxyribonuclease I and 10 % FBS to the digested tissue, then gently dissociate the pieces using fire‑polished Pasteur pipettes.

steps.title: Filter, centrifuge, and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Manually triturate the suspension, filter through a 70 µm Nitex mesh, pellet cells at 375 g for 10 min, and resuspend the pellet in ice‑cold carbogen‑bubbled rinse medium (F12 with 10 % FBS and 1× antibiotic/antimycotic).

substeps.instruction: Filter cell suspension through 70 µm Nitex mesh.
Resuspend pellet in ice‑cold carbogen‑bubbled F12 medium containing 10 % FBS and 1× antibiotic/antimycotic.

steps.title: Count viable cells with Trypan Blue
steps.instruction: Determine viable cell number using the Trypan Blue dye‑exclusion method.

steps.title: Sort viable cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Collect viable cells by fluorescence‑activated cell sorting (FACS) and assess viability with a Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter.

steps.title: Load cells onto Chromium Controller
steps.instruction: Load approximately 10 000 viable cells per suspension onto a 10× Genomics Chromium Controller to generate single‑cell gel‑bead‑in‑emulsion (GEM) droplets.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA library with Chromium kit
steps.instruction: Use the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Reagent Kit v2 Chemistry (10× Genomics) to construct the single‑cell cDNA library according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NextSeq 500 as 1 × 75 bp single‑end reads.

steps.title: Process data with Cell Ranger
steps.instruction: Run Cell Ranger v1.3 (10× Genomics) to generate FASTQ files, align reads to the sus_scrofa genome and transcriptome, and produce a gene‑by‑cell expression matrix.
